semanticLimits: The observed source has no printed version identifier; this is an observation contract, not an invented provider version.

All non-customer household members, adults and children, require an accepted identifier. Opaque requirements are not completed identification and no raw identifier belongs in this formatter or application JSON.
The customer of record's ID and birth date are not required. Do not collect either just to prepare this application.
New enrollment, recertification, re-enrollment and pending work remain distinct. No draft establishes the correct existing-account journey or an amount due.
Gross income evidence, no-income statements, outside financial support and SNAP/housing amounts have separate requirements. Source types do not validate proof or establish a zero-income claim.
The customer and applicable outside supporter complete their actual personal acts. The formatter supplies no signature, date, responsibility assent, payment or financial commitment.
Static unsigned preparation is separate from protected member-ID insertion, final evidence assembly, accepted submission, receipt, reconnection or assistance.
The weekly source ceiling and local field/page limits are engineering bounds, not provider eligibility rules or processing approval.
